selection.name: Fortune's End
selection.description:
Gathers the hero's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and purges enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only purge debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
selection.differences: Fortune's End has an instant cast time with maximum power.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Applies Purifying Flames to all enemies and allies within the effect radius of the main target, dealing 360 magical damage. This applies before the dispel. Heals 44 health per second over 9 seconds.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Applies Rain of Destiny, centered on the main target. Heals/Damages allies/enemies for 60 health per second over 10 seconds. While inside Rain of Destiny, allies/enemies have their heal amplification increased/reduced by 25%.

selection.name: Freezing Field
selection.description: CHANNELED - Surrounds the caster with random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Grants bonus armor while channeling. Lasts 10 seconds.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +50 damage. Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Decreases interval duration by 0.02.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Linken's Sphere. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over 1.75s.

selection.name: Frost Arrows
selection.description: Adds a freezing effect to the hero's attacks, slowing enemy movement, dealing bonus damage and apply Hypothermia stacks. Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.
selection.differences: Has no mana cost, and applies Hypothermia stacks by default.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +20 bonus damage, -4% Hypothermia regen reduction per stack.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Hero attacks now splinter up to 2 enemies within 375 radius of the main target with 50% reduced damage.

selection.name: Frost Shield
categories: PIERCES SPELL IMMUNITY: Allies Yes, Enemies No
selection.description: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +10% damage reduction and provides +50 HP Regen.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Additionally deals 6% of target hero's max HP in an AOE per pulse.

selection.name: Frostbite
selection.description: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Lasts 10 seconds on creeps level 6 or lower.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Duration increased by 1.25 seconds, affected targets take 25% extra damage for the duration of the debuff.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Grants Ice Age: when target unit dies, they shatter, applying Frostbite to every unit globally. Frostbite DPS increased by 100.
